name_zh: 克赖斯基/奥地利/社民/中立/福利/核能/布鲁诺/犹太/布鲁诺
description_zh: 奥托·克赖斯基（1905-1990），奥地利社民党领导人，二战后奥地利总理，推行社会福利政策，支持中立外交，反核能运动领导者，犹太裔政治家，与西奥多·克莱门特有联系，倡导民主社会主义，领导奥地利民主重建。
description_en: Otto Kreisler (1905-1990), Austrian Socialist Party leader, post-WWII Austrian Chancellor, implemented social welfare policies, supported neutrality diplomacy, anti-nuclear movement leader, Jewish political leader, connected with Theodore Krul, advocated democratic socialism, led Austrian democratic reconstruction.
reason_zh: 克赖斯基是二战后奥地利民主重建的关键领导者，推行社会福利政策和中立外交，反核能运动领导者，其社民主义思想对奥地利战后民主转型产生深远影响。
reason_en: Kreisler was key leader of post-WWII Austrian democratic reconstruction, implemented social welfare policies and neutrality diplomacy, anti-nuclear movement leader, his democratic socialist ideas profoundly influenced post-war Austrian democratic transformation.
expected_zh: 建立奥地利民主制度，推行社会福利政策和中立外交，反核能运动领导者，对战后奥地利民主转型和中立政策产生深远影响。
expected_en: Established Austrian democratic system, implemented social welfare policies and neutrality diplomacy, anti-nuclear movement leader, profoundly influenced post-war Austrian democratic transformation and neutrality policy.
